description: This is a C source file implementing pin control functions for the IT8XXX2 series microcontroller within the Zephyr RTOS. It defines data structures, initialization routines, and configuration functions for GPIO and KSI/KSO pin modes, including voltage selection, pull-up/down, and alternate functions.

methods.name: pinctrl_it8xxx2_set
methods.description: Configures individual GPIO pin settings including pull-up/down, voltage, and impedance.

methods.name: pinctrl_gpio_it8xxx2_configure_pins
methods.description: Configures GPIO pins with specific alternate functions and modes.

methods.name: pinctrl_kscan_it8xxx2_set
methods.description: Configures KSI/KSO pins for pull-up, push-pull, or open-drain modes.

methods.name: pinctrl_kscan_it8xxx2_configure_pins
methods.description: Configures KSI/KSO pins with specific modes and functions.

methods.name: pinctrl_configure_pins
methods.description: Iterates over pins and applies GPIO or KSI/KSO configuration.

methods.name: pinctrl_it8xxx2_init
methods.description: Initializes the pin control driver, setting default register states.
